summary: Creates a 40-byte UI list node from a source template, initializes it via sub_5510F0 using template data at a2+0xC, and appends it to the scene's UI list-node chain. When the list head (this+0x214) is non-null the list is walked to the tail along node next pointers (node+0x24) and the new node is linked after it; otherwise the new node becomes the head. Fills the node item count (node+0x14) from the template and writes sequential indices into each item slot (stride 136) of the item array (node+0x18), registers the node with EntityFlagSetSubInitChain, stores the source template pointer in node+0x1C, collects rendering state via sub_557350, and conditionally calls sub_559200 when the this+0x218 flag is zero. Called by SceneNode (0055A910).

local_names.a2: source template the new node is created from
local_names.v3: tail node of the existing UI list chain
local_names.v8: newly created UI list node (same object as v5)
local_names.v7: item count taken from the template
local_names.v13: stack buffer collecting rendering state via sub_557350

operations.description: Branch on the UI list head at this+0x214 (this[133]): when non-null walk the chain to its tail by following node next pointers (node+0x24); when null the new node will become the head. The packet models the chain anchor through the list-state container at this+0x238
Allocate the 40-byte node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and initialize it through sub_5510F0 with the template data at a2+0xC
Link the new node into the chain: set the old tail node's next pointer (node+0x24) to the new node, or store the new node as the head (this+0x214) when the list was empty
Copy the item count from the template (a2+0xC) into the new node's count field (node+0x14)
Write sequential indices 0,1,2,... into the new node's item array (node+0x18) with a stride of 136 bytes per item until the item count is reached
Register the new node through EntityFlagSetSubInitChain for entity flag initialization
Store the source template pointer (a2) in the new node's source field (node+0x1C)
sub_557350 collects rendering state into the local stack buffer
Read the flag at this+0x218 (this[134]); when it is zero, call sub_559200 with the address of this[134] (dword index 134) and the collected state buffer to attach the node state
EmptyStub_0170 called as a no-op marker after the node setup
Invoked by SceneNode (0055A910) while setting up UI scene nodes
